stats.text: You can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the {ref:condition/charmed} or {ref:condition/frightened} condition, you can take a {ref:glossary/reaction} to cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has {ref:glossary/advantage}.
